texts.preamble: Yatin Sharma vs Food Safety And Standards Authority Of ... on 20 February, 2024 Author: Subramonium Prasad Bench: Subramonium Prasad $~12 * In The High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi + W.P.(C) 8774/2023 Yatin Sharma Th ve Food Safety And Standards Authority Of I (Fssai) & Ors. Through: Mr. Rakesh Chaud Tanvi, Advocates Mr. Vikas Kumar, Mr. Utkarsh Sing Srivastava, Advo Santosh Kumar Tr Gnctd/R-3. Ms. Pratima N. L Mr. Kashish G. B R-4. Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Subramonium Prasad Or % 20.02.2024 1.
texts.facts: The Petitioner has approached this Court with the following prayers: "a) Direct the Respondent No. 1, 3 & 4 to initiate strict and prompt action against Respondent No. 2. This may include imposing heavy fines, cancelling their FSSAI license, and even imposing imprisonment on the owners of Respondent No. 2. Furthermore, the Court may order for sealing the outlets owned by Respondent No. 2 that are found to be in violation of the norms and This is a digitally signed order. The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above. c) Direct Respondent No. 1 takes immediate corrective measures to rectify their non-compliance and strengthen their oversight to prevent similar incidents in the future. The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 23/02/2024 at 22:28:13 Velvet Muffin, the Petitioner fell ill and thereafter, filed a complaint with the Respondent No.1/FSSAI.
texts.arguments: d) Hold Respondent No. 1 accountable for their negligence and dereliction of duty, and send a strong message that endangering the lives and emotions of citizens through the issuance of licenses to incapable food business operators willnot be tolerated. e) Uphold the principles of Article 21 of the Constitution of India, which guarantees the right to life and personal liberty, by ensuring that food safety and standards are effectively enforced and upheld by Respondent No. 1. f) The court may pass such other and further orders as this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and necessary in the facts and circumstances of the case." 2. It is the case of the Petitioner that he purchased a Red Velvet Muffin from the Respondent No.2/shop.
